computeState(bytes32).details: CRITICAL: Uses age relative to lastConfirmedBlock (NOT publishBlock).

confirm(bytes32).details: CRITICAL: Must accept 4 states (SUBMITTED, ACTIVE, DECAYING, CHALLENGED).

purge(bytes32).details: Pull-withdrawal pattern: credits pendingWithdrawals instead of      direct ETH transfer. Cleanup caller gets 5%, author gets 10%.

searchSimilar(bytes,uint8).details: searchSimilar is not available in v1 precompile. Returns empty      arrays. Off-chain indexers should use emitted vectors + isSimilar.

submit(uint8,bytes,bytes).details: Duplicate detection: The v1 precompile does not have searchSimilar.      The full vector is emitted in InsightPublished so off-chain indexers      can detect near-duplicates using HdcLib.isSimilar (opcode 0x06).

challenge(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Challenge an ACTIVE insight by referencing anti-knowledge.

computeState(bytes32).notice: Compute the current lifecycle state of an insight.

confirmers(bytes32,address).notice: Tracks which addresses have confirmed each insight.

insights(bytes32).notice: All insights by their unique ID.

purge(bytes32).notice: Purge a PURGED insight. Clears storage, credits partial stake         to author and cleanup caller via pendingWithdrawals.

renew(bytes32).notice: Renew an ARCHIVED insight. Requires fresh stake >= MIN_STAKE.

searchSimilar(bytes,uint8).notice: Search for similar vectors via the HDC precompile.

submit(uint8,bytes,bytes).notice: Submit a new insight with stake.
